extract_docs: extract retrieved documents from a dialog data dictionary using the __retrieved-docs__ key
extract_sentences: extract selected sentences or fallback text from a dialog data dictionary
extract_context: extract the context text from the first turn of a dialog data dictionary
get_5_docs: get up to 5 relevant external knowledge documents from dialog data with real and sampled docs
get_personas: extract and format persona information for self and partner from dialog retrieved documents
